_meta.purpose: In-market local TV and streaming for each team, 2026-27. Replaces data/local_tv.json in jsierrahoopshype/nba-watch-guide.

confidence_rules.high: Official 2026-27 source. Counts in coverage maths.
confidence_rules.moderate: Dated 2026 secondary reporting. Counts in coverage maths but must render a check-before-you-buy note.
confidence_rules.low: Conflicting or stale sources. Never counts in coverage maths. Page shows what is known plus 'Local details for 2026-27 not confirmed yet.'
confidence_rules.unknown: Not announced. Never counts. Page says so plainly.

_meta.antenna_channels: Optional per team: over-the-air stations with their virtual (antenna) channel, e.g. "32.1". names are the channel names the station appears under (the schedule feed's codes and local_broadcasters), matched exactly. Shown on chips and the team page only when status is "confirmed", virtual looks like "32.1" and checked is set. A number counts as confirmed when FCC data agrees with Wikipedia: sources hold an FCC URL (the LMS facility page) and a Wikipedia URL (a permanent revision). FCC records only the major number, so it confirms a station's main programming, not a subchannel. RabbitEars.info may stand in for FCC only when FCC can't be read, never paired with Wikipedia alone (Wikipedia cites RabbitEars), so it needs a third site; otherwise it is recorded as supporting, not counted. Sources that disagree, or only one, leave it unset. Never a cable or satellite number; streaming apps and regional networks get no entry. not_applicable marks a name that covers several stations, or one with no single number.
_meta.short_names: Optional per team: {full name: short name} for a local broadcaster or streaming option whose name is too long for a channel chip. Chips show the short name with the full name in the title attribute; every other place keeps the full name.

coverage_rules.scope: Local options only cover the team's games that have no national broadcaster, and only for a reader in the team's market.
coverage_rules.ota_all: ota.status 'all' means every local game is free over the air: counts as free coverage for every non-national game.
coverage_rules.ota_partial: ota.status 'partial' or 'most' is NOT coverage. We do not know which games. Render as a text line only.
coverage_rules.streaming: A streaming option with a non-null monthly_price_usd covers every non-national game at that monthly price. A null price means it is listed but cannot enter a priced combination.
